title: Sergey Ten: Duma State has passed a law aimed at the safety of Russian roads
text:
Law No. 542769-8 “Regarding amendments to the administrative law of the Russian Federation” has been developed as part of the “United Russia” Party project “Safety Road” with the support of the Russian Ministry of Transport, as well as a professional community, activists and regional volunteers. He made comprehensive modifications to improve the safety standards of the Russian road.
– We have worked on this law for nearly two years. Annual losses, caused by heavy vehicles with our lines, is estimated with the amount of about two trillion rubles. It can be compared with funding for the country's road industry. All bridge structures are destroyed in the areas of Nizhny Novgorod and Amur, in Krasnoyarsk territory. In my opinion, this is a disrespect for the workers' workers. Moreover, the practice of law enforcement on the inefficiency of the law, action so far, has shown its inefficiency, the comment of the Federal Coordinator of the Party Project, Safe Safe Roads, Deputy Duma of the Russian Federation Sergey Ten.
The law on the approved version is the improvement of the law on criminal acts to ensure the effectiveness of the existing rules and orders to realize the real situation of our roads.
The initiators of the law set up administrative responsibilities for the driver of the vehicle where the driver of the car is the official's request for adoption of weight and overall control, as well as violating the rules for the movement of heavy and large vehicles in the region with automatic weight and overall control. Increase the statute of limitations for limits for administrative responsibilities from two months to a year for the offenses of heavy means. The spelled measures to increase the effectiveness of the work put into operation a special license system for heavy competitors through the responsibility to provide timely information of the road owners.
Part 2 of Article 12.25 on the Administration Code will also affect, in which the large increase in the size of the fines for the drivers of the car is provided for the failure to comply with the police requirements of the police and Rostransnadzor, as well as the driver's driver's license.
